answer: Sybil defence is arithmetic. Postal worker tenure with national post attestation prices each identity at tenure is years of payroll and route records in a state system, so faking a hundred. The orchard is the asymmetry: verification takes seconds and costs nothing, while fabrication takes years and costs a fortune. One fake is a rounding error; a thousand is a business losing money on every unit, and the ocean in each unit is a real person doing real things. The lotus is the audit trail.
